title: Gaudi magic
text: Estella was wonderful! She made exploring Gaudí’s incredible houses such a fun and memorable experience. Her knowledge, enthusiasm, and personal touch brought the architecture and stories to life. A fantastic tour with Panda Tours—I highly recommend them and Estella!
author: lavisser

title: Great day with Gaudi
text: Fantastic! Katherine was so knowledgeable and enthusiastic and brought Gaudi to life! Sagrada Família was amazing as well.

title: This was a wonderful...
text: This was a wonderful day!! Montserrat is stunning. Our guide Mariana with Catalunya Bus Turistic was outstanding, very knowledgeable, passionate about the monastery, and extremely patient. Be careful to check dates about The Boys Choir to ensure it is the right season and they are performing.

title: Worth it
text: The four of us really enjoyed our recent tour in Barcelona. Roger our guide was very informative and talkative during our visit to Casa de Vincens. Added insights while walking made the tour special as the places pointed out were very obscure and unique.  The guided part of La Familia de Sagrada was also informative but the headsets could have been better. Overall we will enjoyed our trip.

title: A gem! Amazing near private tour experience.
text: Incredible experience in this gem that I found by chance and luck when looking for a Korean language tour for family members. With a smaller group that Touring Panda ensures, it was a very personal experience with a ton of detail, fun stories, and a very friendly feeling from a engaging and kind guide (Hwa-Jin). We were only in Barcelona for a very short amount of time, so every hour counted.  This tour was exactly what we needed. title: Wonderful Gaudí Experience – Highly Recommend!
text:
This tour was excellent from start to finish. The first guide for the Gaudí houses was friendly, knowledgeable, and provided lots of interesting information about the architecture and history. The second guide at La Sagrada Família was absolutely fantastic — fun, engaging, and full of fascinating details that brought the entire experience to life.

I really enjoyed both parts of the tour and learned so much. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to truly appreciate Gaudí’s genius!
author: Kathryn_Y

title: Enjoyed Gaudi sites but scheduling issues put a bit of a damper on the day
text: I booked an all day tour in Barcelona for myself, husband and two teenage sons—since we only had one full day in Barcelona. The Gaudi houses (morning) and Sagrada Familia (afternoon) are wonderful works of architecture and we enjoyed them very much. Our tour guide in the morning, Fei, was knowledgeable and very nice. Our afternoon guide, Adria, was simply exceptional, very entertaining and engaging for even our two teen sons who do not tend to enjoy all-day tours.
